# Event details

An event’s name, then what, when, where and cost, with a link.

Include `gg/event-details.html` · Figma: Event details · Formats: web, flyer, postcard, social · Decisions: D-033, D-034 · Rules: VOICE-010, NAMES-003, NAMES-004, NAMES-005, NAMES-006

The contract is `_data/components/event-details.yml` (COMP-002). Sources are explained in [Components](../../brand/system/components.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  | request | The headline is the event’s name (VOICE-010). |
| `what` | text | yes |  | request | One sentence. |
| `when` | text | yes |  | request | As NAMES-005 writes it. |
| `where` | text | yes |  | request | As people say the place, then the address once (NAMES-006). |
| `cost` | text | yes |  | request |  |
| `link` | text | no |  | request | The button’s label, such as ‘Link in bio’. With href it links there; in a social image, where nothing can be clicked, it shows as the same pill without a link. Leave out for print. |
| `href` | url | no |  | request |  |
